```md
This is literal example text:
<span id="rd-c1">anchored text</span>
<span id="rd-c2"></span>
<ins id="rd-s1">inserted</ins>
<del id="rd-s2">deleted</del>
<span id="rd-s3"><del>old</del><ins>new</ins></span>
```

Inline code stays literal: `<span id="rd-c1">not an anchor</span>` and `<ins id="rd-s1">not a suggestion</ins>`.
